name: smwgraphics-super-princess-peach-exclamation-clouds-and-springs
title: Super Princess Peach - Exclamation Clouds and Springs
description:
These are springs and the exclamation clouds that both appear from Super Princess Peach. There are 2 versions of the springs, the small one to replace the default vanilla one and a 32x32 version fitted for giant themed levels. For the bigger spring, it is highly suggested to use its GFX with
Sonikku's Giant Springboard
https://www.smwcentral.net/?p=section&a=details&id=22249
. For the exclamation clouds they can have multiple uses. Be careful too when using the giant springboard too, as it uses almost all of palette D.

Rykon-V73 Edit: The springboards have reduced animations due to repeating tiles.
